violations.text: A sticky fly trap and a plug-in vector light was observed above/near food prep areas. Traps and plug-in vector lights must be installed in a manner to prevent the possible contamination of food. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine has an accumulation of pink residue. The non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned as often as necessary to prevent the possible contamination of food. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Hashbrowns were placed hot in the refrigerator in a plastic bag. Hashbrowns moved to sheet pan into freezer to rapidly cool. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/16/2025
